settings.content: Our work is grounded in advanced training in trauma treatment, psychological evaluation, and integrative clinical care. We draw from evidence-based and experiential approaches to provide individualized treatment that is both clinically rigorous and responsive to the needs of each client.

settings.content: Certified EMDR Therapist and EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Advanced training in Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing to support the processing of trauma and other distressing experiences.

settings.text: Training in MBSR has informed Dr. Serravalle's work in helping clients develop greater awareness of internal experience, reduce reactivity, and build more intentional responses to stress.
